_about: A Night Out: each downtime action plays as a short scene in the district you spend the gap in. SAFE is the rulebook action as written. BOLD is the same action with a bonus on a win and a cost on a loss, always opt-in. Scene text can use {district}, {place}, {faction}, {hazard}, {wisdom}, {mood}, {name}; they fill from data/places.json (the district dossier and its places). Add situations freely: one is drawn at random each time. Effects: heat, stress, credits (a cost you can't pay becomes Debt), standing (your Standing in this district's territory), wound (steps toward Unharmed), condition (clear one), lead (a true line from the district dossier lands in your Mail).

layLow.name: Lay Low
situations: {place} is quiet tonight, or quiet enough. Nobody here is looking for you yet.
A sweep came through {district} an hour ago. The block is still holding its breath.
Somewhere near {place}, someone owes you a couch and a closed mouth.

safe.label: Stay in. Doors shut, lights off.
safe.text: Doors shut, lights off, phone face down. The block forgets you were ever loud.

bold.label: Lie low somewhere you can listen.

win.text: You keep your head down and your ears open.

partial.text: Quiet night. Nothing worth hearing.

lose.text: Someone clocked you watching. You still got off the street, but your nerves didn't.

workContact.name: Work a Contact
workContact.rule: Savvy + Network. Success or partial: Standing +1 here.
situations: Your contact near {place} is closing up early. Somebody was by today, asking about your crew.
There's a table at {place} where people trade favors in low voices. Yours is open, for now.
A friend-of-a-friend in {district} wants to know if you're still good for it.

safe.label: Help out. Be the one they can count on.

win.text: They remember who showed up.

partial.text: It cost you an evening and a little face, but they'll vouch.

lose.text: Wrong night. They're polite, and that's all.

win.text: They tell you more than they meant to, and like you better for asking.

partial.text: You get the nod, not the answer.

lose.text: The question got back to the wrong ears.

recover.name: Recover
recover.rule: Clear one Condition, or move the Wound Track one step toward Unharmed.
situations: Everything hurts in the specific way that means you're still alive.
There's a back-room clinic near {place}. Cash, no names, questionable gloves.
You could sleep for a week. You've got a night.

safe.label: Rest. Actually rest.
safe.text: You sleep like it's a job. For once, it pays.

win.text: They're good. Scary good. You walk out better than you walked in.

partial.text: Patched, mostly. The bill is the cure's ugly cousin.

lose.text: One step better, and a bill for the privilege.

community.name: Community
community.rule: Spend time with someone who matters. Stress -2, or -3 in your grith.
situations: Somebody saved you a seat at {place}.
There's food, bad music and worse jokes, and none of it is about work.
{wisdom}

safe.label: Just be there.
safe.text: Nobody asks about work. Nobody needs to.

bold.label: Bring them into what you're carrying.

win.text: They're in. The block has your back a little more than yesterday.

partial.text: They listen. They don't promise.

lose.text: It got heavy. You still needed tonight, just less of it landed.

research.name: Research
research.rule: Investigate a person, place or faction. One true piece of information.
situations: Records about {faction} are supposed to be sealed. Supposed to be.
Everyone in {district} knows something about {place}. Nobody agrees on what.
The paper trail for {hazard} leads somewhere nobody wants it to.

win.text: One thing you can count on.

partial.text: You got it, and somebody noticed you getting it.

lose.text: Dead ends and polite liars.

bold.label: Pull the file you're not supposed to see.

win.text: Two true things, and the shape of a third.

partial.text: You got one, and left a fingerprint.

lose.text: Access logged. Somebody upstairs is going to read it.

sideJob.name: Side Job
sideJob.rule: Earn credits. A Side Job may generate Heat.
situations: {class}

win.text: Paid, clean, home before the lights go out.

partial.text: Half pay. They found something to complain about.

lose.text: No pay. Nobody got hurt, at least.

win.text: Real money. Someone's going to wonder where it came from.

partial.text: Paid, and noticed.

lose.text: It went sideways. You walked; the money didn't.

Wrench.text: A generator in {district} is coughing itself to death. The owner can pay, a little.

Striker.text: {place} needs a door that stays shut tonight. You're the door.

Ghost.text: Somebody wants a record in {district} to be less true than it is.

Signal.text: Radio Sewers has a slot open, and a crowd at {place} that wants something loud.

Shade.text: A shop near {place} has a feeling in the back room. They'd like it gone, or at least quieter.

Broker.text: Two people in {district} want the same thing and won't talk to each other. They'll talk to you.

Warden.text: Off-shift security at {place}. Walk the floor, look like trouble wouldn't be worth it.

Runner.text: A package needs to cross {district} faster than the official way allows.

_any.text: There's work in {district} for anyone who shows up and doesn't ask much.

train.name: Train
train.rule: Spend Marks to raise a skill one rank (Trained at level 2, Expert at 11, Mastery at 16).

putDownRoots.name: Put Down Roots
putDownRoots.rule: Gain grithrakt in this district. Needs fiction; the next session's GM confirms it.

settleAccount.name: Settle an Account
settleAccount.rule: Close an open divine Account once its price is met. The GM confirms.

craft.name: Craft
craft.rule: Wrench only. Build or modify gear in the Workshop.

Ma Dresk.name: Ma Dresk's favor
Ma Dresk.rule: Settles your late rent at The Hive, whichever way the roll goes. The roll decides whether she's pleased.
situations: Your rent at The Hive is past its grace week. Ma Dresk has a few things that need doing, and one of them has your name on it.
Ma Dresk catches you on the stairs at The Hive. Neither elevator is working, so there's no escaping her. Your rent's late, and she's got work.

walkin.label: The Fryer's walk-in cooler is dying again.

win.text: It hums like new. Ma Dresk is pleased, which is worth something in this building.

partial.text: It runs. Probably until next week.

lose.text: It runs, after a whole night on your back on a greasy floor.

parcel.label: A wrapped parcel needs to get across Low Halo, no questions.

win.text: Delivered fast and clean. Ma Dresk is pleased, which is worth something in this building.

partial.text: Delivered. Late, but delivered.

lose.text: Delivered, but somebody noticed you carrying it.

collector.label: Someone's collector keeps leaning on her tenants.

win.text: He won't be back. Ma Dresk is pleased, which is worth something in this building.

partial.text: He left. He'll think about coming back.

lose.text: He left, and he'll remember your face.

The Oduya-Venn family.name: The Oduya-Venns' favor
The Oduya-Venn family.rule: Settles your late rent in the North Market, whichever way the roll goes. The roll decides how the family talks about you afterwards.
situations: Grandmother Oduya-Venn has your name on her list, and today it's next to a job.
The stall's short-handed and your rent's late. Tobin is already pretending he didn't see you.

stall.label: Run the family stall through a market rush.

win.text: Best takings of the month. Grandmother writes something next to your name.

partial.text: Nothing stolen, nothing special.

lose.text: Short-changed twice. Grandmother counts it in front of you.

supplier.label: A supplier promised spice by Tuesday. It's Friday.

win.text: The spice arrives with an apology and a discount.

partial.text: Half the order, no apology.

lose.text: The supplier now dislikes you personally.

lane.label: Two neighbors, one shared wall, a lot of shouting.

win.text: Both of them thank you, which hasn't happened before.

partial.text: The shouting stops. The wall is still disputed.

lose.text: Now they're both shouting at you.

Auntie Pell.name: Auntie Pell's favor
Auntie Pell.rule: Settles your late rent at the Mended Stair, whichever way the roll goes. The roll decides what Auntie Pell says about you on the landing.
situations: Auntie Pell is waiting at the top of the stair. Your rent is late. She has a list.
The rail's loose again, and Auntie Pell has decided it's your turn.

rail.label: The landing rail is one bad night from coming off the wall.

win.text: Solid as the day it went up. Auntie Pell pats it, then you.

partial.text: It holds. It creaks.

lose.text: It holds, after two bloody knuckles and a lecture.

sit.label: Old Moraine on the second floor shouldn't be alone tonight.

win.text: Moraine sleeps easy, and so does the stair.

partial.text: A long night. Everyone's still here in the morning.

lose.text: A long, bad night. Moraine pulls through. You barely sleep.

shop.kicker: Have a word with the shop
shop.label: The shop next door keeps dumping its crates on her landing.

win.text: The crates stop. The shopkeeper waves now, nervously.

partial.text: The crates move to the next landing over.

lose.text: The shopkeeper calls the Wardens on you.

The Roadside Rest.name: The Roadside Rest's favor
The Roadside Rest.rule: Settles your late rent at the Roadside Rest, whichever way the roll goes. The roll decides whether you get a room next time.
situations: A wagon's stuck out on the east road, and the family is looking at you.
It's a busy night at the Rest, your rent is late, and somebody has to mind the bar.

wagon.kicker: Ride out to a stuck wagon
wagon.label: A supply wagon is axle-deep in mud, an hour out.

win.text: The wagon is back by dark with everyone on it.

partial.text: The wagon's back by morning.

lose.text: The wagon comes back. You come back on foot.

bar.label: Every bed is full, the stove's roaring and the bar is three deep.

win.text: A good night. Someone buys you a drink for a change.

partial.text: Nobody fights. That's a win out here.

lose.text: Somebody fights. You lose a tooth's worth of pride.

trouble.label: A drifter has been helping himself to the larder.

win.text: He leaves, and he takes the hint to the next stop too.

partial.text: He leaves. He might come back.

lose.text: He leaves, and takes your boots.

Granny Tikka Rattle.name: Granny Rattle's favor
Granny Tikka Rattle.rule: Settles your late rent at the Coil Lane walk-ups, whichever way the roll goes. The roll decides whether Granny lets you near the good tools.
situations: Granny Rattle is standing in the shop door with a wrench in one hand and your rent in the other.
Third Rattle Motors is behind on jobs, you're behind on rent, and Granny has noticed both.

engine.label: A cargo hauler's engine has to come apart by morning.

win.text: Clean, labelled and done by dawn. Granny says nothing, which is high praise.

partial.text: Done. One bolt left over.

lose.text: Done, eventually, with a burn to show for it.

customer.label: A courier took her bike back without paying for the rebuild.

win.text: Paid in full, with an apology.

partial.text: Half paid, and a promise.

lose.text: Not paid, and now the courier's crew knows your face.

part.label: A coil for a model that hasn't been made in thirty years.

win.text: Found it in the Scrapfields, and a spare.

partial.text: Found something that'll do.

lose.text: Three days of looking, and a lot of rust.

The Wennick boats.name: Captain Wennick's favor
The Wennick boats.rule: Settles your late rent at the Brown Steps Moorings, whichever way the roll goes. The roll decides whether the captain trusts you with the wheel.
situations: Captain Wennick is waiting on the Brown Steps. Your rent is late, and the river is up.
Someone's been cutting mooring lines at night, and the captain wants it to stop.

night-run.label: A barge needs to get down the Ashrun before the morning checks.

win.text: In and out before first light. The captain lets you steer on the way back.

partial.text: Made it, a little late.

lose.text: Made it, after a Meridian launch took a long look.

hull.label: A houseboat is taking on water, slowly.

win.text: Dry by midnight.

partial.text: Dry, if you keep the bucket handy.

lose.text: Dry, eventually. You are not.

lines.label: Three boats came loose last week.

win.text: You know who, and why. The captain handles it.

partial.text: You know why. Not who.

lose.text: You get spotted watching, and the cutting stops for now.
